stem: Maggie wants a better ending for her paper. Which sentence can be added after sentence 22 to bring this paper to a more effective close?

options.label: F
options.text: With the combined efforts of many people, it’s quite possible that the amazing rhinoceros will be saved from extinction.

options.label: G
options.text: If the breeding programs work, there will be more rhinos in zoos soon.

options.label: H
options.text: Finally, the rhinoceros that so many people love will survive, and it will probably be around for years to come.

options.label: J
options.text: And that will be the end of the worries about rhinos.
